title: Aleppo teachers’ public sit-in over wages and employment status
scope: One reported public square sit-in by educators from northern Aleppo education complexes.
organizer: Unknown; an earlier union call is mentioned but not linked conclusively to this gathering.

state_target.evidence: Source says participants called on the Ministry to reconsider wage suspension, employment status and dismissal decisions.

demands_original: Teachers sought delayed wage payment, employment-status clarification, reinstatement, and Ministry reconsideration.
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance figure or qualitative estimate establishes 50 simultaneous attendees at the square.

start_date.summary: SANA reports the sit-in on 7 September 2025.

state_target.summary: Participants directly called on the Ministry of Education to reconsider its decisions.

demands.summary: Delayed wages, employment-status clarification, reinstatement and process for employment/merger.

organizer.summary: Specific organizer for this sit-in unknown; source mentions earlier union call only.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence reported; silence is not coded as no.

notes: SANA is a state news agency; its account is not independently corroborated in this capture. Search leads about a Damascus sit-in and other labor issues were not verified as executed gatherings.
open_questions: Did the Damascus missing-persons lead correspond to an executed September gathering?
